review_candidates.title: Amazon Connect Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization, and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%. Job Description We are looking for an Amazon Connect Support Engineer who will be responsible for supporting and maintaining AWS-based CCaaS and contact center environments to ensure high availability and system reliability. The role focuses on monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues using observability tools such as Splunk and Zabbix. This role offers the opportunity to develop broad expertise across multiple leading CCaaS platforms in a modern enterprise contact center environment. Responsibilities Design, develop, and enhance proactive monitoring capabilities for the AWS Connect CCaaS platform to ensure system reliability and operational excellence. Collaborate closely with developers, architects, and platform owners to enforce logging standards and monitoring best practices that enable effective troubleshooting and observability. Participate in application design sessions and develop end-to-end interaction flows using Splunk to strengthen monitoring and diagnostics capabilities. Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions to minimize system downtime and service disruptions. Work with vendor partners to drive operational improvements and enhance monitoring frameworks across the platform. Develop and maintain CloudWatch dashboards as a complementary monitoring solution to ensure redundancy and visibility. Qualifications 4+ years of overall IT experience with strong exposure to CCaaS environments. Solid experience in contact center observability, monitoring, and troubleshooting of production systems. 2+ years of hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Splunk and CloudWatch. Practical AWS cloud experience, including Lambda, Amazon Connect, Application Load Balancers (ALBs). Experience in at least one scripting language such as Python or JavaScript to support automation and operational efficiency. Excellent communication and teamwork skills with the ability to collaborate across technical teams. Nice To Have Experience with NICE CXone and/or Genesys Cloud/Genesys Engage contact center platforms Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Zabbix We offer: Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth. Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program. Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work. Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities. Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries. Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events. Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality. Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law. Additional Information All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

review_candidates.title: 1. Site Engineer - Building Construction
review_candidates.company: Nidhi Land Infrastructure Developers India (P) Ltd.
review_candidates.description: Company Description Nidhi Land Infrastructure Developers India (P) Ltd. is a real estate developer and builder based in Mangalore with over a decade of experience in commercial and residential projects. The company is committed to staying at the forefront of a rapidly evolving construction and development industry. Its work is anchored in trust, customer satisfaction, value creation, and high standards of business ethics, environmental sustainability, and fair-trade practices. Nidhi Land focuses on crafting safe, high-quality, and efficient spaces that exceed expectations while fostering meaningful collaborations and empowering its team. The organization is dedicated to building a future defined by trust, quality, and purpose across all its projects. About the Role Nidhi Land Infrastructure Developers India (P) Ltd. is looking for an experienced Site Engineer to supervise and manage the day-to-day execution of its building construction projects in Mangalore. The candidate must have strong practical experience in residential or commercial building construction and should be familiar with local construction practices, materials, labour management and execution techniques. Key Responsibilities - Supervise and manage day-to-day construction activities at the project site. - Execute work according to approved architectural, structural and MEP drawings. - Ensure that construction activities are completed according to approved specifications, quality standards and project schedules. - Plan and coordinate daily and weekly site activities. - Coordinate with project managers, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, labour teams and internal departments. - Check line, level, dimensions, reinforcement, shuttering and other construction details before and during execution. - Supervise civil works including excavation, foundations, RCC works, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, flooring and finishing works. - Inspect reinforcement, formwork and embedded items before concrete pours. - Monitor concreting activities and ensure proper placement, compaction, curing and quality control. - Ensure that the latest approved drawings are available and followed at the site. - Identify discrepancies between drawings and actual site conditions and report them promptly. - Monitor labour productivity, material consumption and construction progress. - Raise timely requirements for construction materials, equipment and manpower. - Control material wastage and ensure proper storage and handling of materials. - Maintain daily progress reports, labour records, material records and other site documentation. - Coordinate inspections and approvals with consultants and the project management team. - Verify measurements and quantities of work completed by subcontractors. - Assist in checking subcontractor bills and work completion quantities. - Ensure that all work is carried out safely and that workers follow site safety requirements. - Identify delays, quality concerns and site-related issues and take timely corrective action. - Ensure proper housekeeping and organisation at the construction site. - Support the project team in achieving construction milestones and timely project completion. Educational Qualification - B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering; or - Diploma in Civil Engineering. Experience - Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in building construction. - Experience in residential apartments, high-rise buildings or commercial building projects is preferred. - Candidates with experience limited only to roads, highways, infrastructure or non-building projects may not be suitable for this position. Required Technical Knowledge - Strong knowledge of building construction methods and execution procedures. - Good understanding of local construction practices and techniques. - Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural and MEP drawings. - Knowledge of RCC, reinforcement, shuttering, masonry, waterproofing, finishing and related building works. - Understanding of construction materials, workmanship standards and quality-control procedures. - Knowledge of construction sequencing and site planning. - Familiarity with quantity measurements, subcontractor work verification and site documentation. - Awareness of construction safety practices. - Basic working knowledge of AutoCAD, Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office is preferred. Required Skills - Site execution - Building construction - Construction supervision - RCC works - Reinforcement and shuttering inspection - Drawing interpretation - Labour and subcontractor management - Quality control - Material management - Progress monitoring - Site documentation - Construction safety - Problem-solving - Team coordination - Time management Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should: - Have strong practical and hands-on construction knowledge. - Be familiar with local labour, materials and construction practices in and around Mangalore. - Be capable of independently supervising site activities. - Be disciplined, responsible and quality-focused. - Be able to coordinate effectively with different site teams. - Have good communication and reporting skills. - Be willing to take ownership of assigned construction activities. - Be comfortable working full-time at the project site. Work Location Mangalore, Karnataka ·       This is a full-time, on-site position. Candidates must be willing to work from the assigned project location in Mangalore. Job Title : Site Engineer - Building Construction

КОГО МЫ ИЩЕМ ​ Мы ищем кандидатов с… ​ ​Опыт работы в Визуальном мерчандайзинге и коммерческой сфере в динамичной среде, а также с навыками решения проблем. Умением управлять, анализировать и принимать решения на основе отчетов о продажах и коммерческих показателей. Мы ценим кандидатов, которые… ​ Увлечены модой и стремятся создавать исключительный покупательский опыт. Мотивированы на создание выдающегося покупательского сервиса, активно продвигая и увеличивая продажи. Креативны, любознательны и проактивны. Обладают хорошими коммуникативными навыками, умеют вдохновлять и направлять команду магазина для достижения общих результатов. Гибки и ориентированы на действия. КТО МЫ ​ H&M Group — это глобальная компания, объединяющая сильные модные бренды и инновационные проекты. Мы стремимся доказать, что стильный дизайн, доступные цены и устойчивые решения могут идти рука об руку. Мы хотим сделать моду доступной для всех, и наши покупатели находятся в центре каждого принятого решения.​ Наша команда состоит из тысяч увлеченных и талантливых людей, объединенных общей культурой и ценностями. Вместе мы используем свои возможности, масштаб и знания, чтобы двигать индустрию моды в сторону более инклюзивного и устойчивого будущего. ​ ПОЧЕМУ ВАМ ПОНРАВИТСЯ У НАС РАБОТАТЬ ​ В H&M Group мы гордимся тем, что создаем яркую и дружелюбную рабочую среду. Мы предлагаем нашим сотрудникам привлекательные условия и широкие возможности для профессионального роста по всему миру. ​ 25% Скидка для сотрудников на все бренды H&M Group, как в магазинах, так и онлайн (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).​ Медицинское страхование здоровья Подарок к рождению ребенка Реферальная программа Безграничные карьерные возможности Платформа для обучения Learning Studio ПРИСОЕДИНЯЙТЕСЬ К НАМ ​ Наша уникальность заключается в сочетании многих факторов: инклюзивной и сплоченной культуры, сильных ценностей и возможностей для развития. Но самое главное — это люди, которые делают нас теми, кто мы есть.​ Сделайте следующий шаг в своей карьере вместе с нами. Ваше путешествие начинается здесь.​ * Мы стремимся к справедливому и объективному процессу найма, основанному на компетенциях. Поэтому просим вас не прикреплять сопроводительное письмо к вашей заявке . ​

Hier erleben Kund*innen unsere Marke hautnah. Jedes Teammitglied, ob im Verkauf, Management oder Visual-Bereich, trägt dazu bei, eine inspirierende Atmosphäre zu schaffen. Du bist eng mit dem Area-Team und vor allem dem Area Visual Merchandise Manager vernetzt, um Erkenntnisse zu teilen und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern. Zusammen mit deinem Team machst du Mode für alle zugänglich. WER DU BIST ​ Wir suchen Talente mit … echter Leidenschaft für Mode, einem Gespür für Trends und dem Wunsch, ein einzigartiges Einkaufserlebnis für unsere Kund*innen zu schaffen. einem guten Blick für visuelle Präsentation, Erfahrung im Umbau von Verkaufsflächen und einer flexiblen, lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise. Und Talente, die … motiviert sind, Kund*innen zu begeistern und gleichzeitig den Umsatz zu steigern und die Marke zu stärken. kreativ, neugierig und proaktiv sind. starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten besitzen und Store Teams inspirieren. Wir glauben daran, dass herausragendes Design, erschwingliche Preise und nachhaltige Lösungen keine Gegensätze sein müssen. Im Mittelpunkt all unserer Entscheidungen stehen unsere Kund*innen. Unsere Unternehmenskultur wird von tausenden leidenschaftlichen und talentierten Teammitgliedern geprägt. Gemeinsam nutzen wir unsere Größe und unser Wissen, um die Fashionbranche in eine inklusivere und nachhaltigere Zukunft zu führen. ​ DARUM WIRST DU ES LIEBEN, BEI UNS ZU ARBEITEN ​ Wir sind stolz darauf, ein lebendiges und offenes Unternehmen zu sein. Unsere Teammitglieder profitieren von attraktiven Vorteilen und vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten weltweit. Mitarbeitendenrabatt auf all unsere Produkte und Marken 30 Tage Urlaub Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld Gehalt nach geltendem Tarif HIP H&M Incentive Program - H&M Group Betriebliche Altersvorsorge Vermögenswirksame Leistungen WERDE TEIL UNSERES TEAMS ​ Unsere Stärke und Einzigartigkeit liegt in vielen Dingen – in unserer inklusiven Kultur, unseren starken Werten und den Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Doch vor allem sind es unsere Teammitglieder, die uns zu dem machen, was wir sind. Werde Teil unseres Teams und mach den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere mit uns – die Reise beginnt hier. ​ * Sobald du auf den Link klickst verlässt du unsere Seite und wirst zu Spotify weitergeleitet. Unsere Teams bestehen aus einer Vielzahl von Menschen, die ihr Wissen, ihre Erfahrung und ihre Ideen miteinander teilen und kombinieren. Vielfältige Teams wirken sich positiv auf die Art und Weise aus, wie wir Herausforderungen angehen, auf das, was wir für möglich halten, und auf die Art und Weise, wie wir mit unseren Teammitgliedern und Kund*innen auf der ganzen Welt arbeiten.
